intro: Moldovan culture shares much with Romania, from folk music to food, and has had some surprising pop hits.

chapters.title: Music
text: The 2003 pop song 'Dragostea din tei' by the Moldovan band O-Zone became a worldwide hit and an early internet meme. Moldova's Eurovision act featuring 'Epic Sax Guy' also went viral.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: National Wine Day in October is a big festival, and Moldovan and Romanian traditional carpets are on UNESCO's heritage list.

keyTerms.meaning: An idea, image or video spread widely online.
